title: Structural Steel Fabrication in Pakistan | Steel Mind Engineers
description: Steel Mind Engineers fabricates columns, beams, trusses, mezzanine floors, bridges and crane gantries to drawing. Quality-checked steel for projects across Pakistan.
h1: Structural Steel Fabrication in Pakistan: Columns, Beams, Trusses and Complete Frames
quickAnswer: Structural steel fabrication is the making of load-carrying steel parts from plates and sections. The parts are cut, drilled, welded and painted in a workshop, then bolted or welded together on site. Steel Mind Engineers fabricates to your drawings or to drawings prepared by its own engineers.
alt: Structural steel frame of columns and beams being bolted on site in Pakistan.

faq.q: Can Steel Mind Engineers fabricate from my drawings?
faq.a: Yes. Send the drawings and the engineer will review them and quote.

faq.q: Does Steel Mind Engineers erect the steel as well?
faq.a: Yes. Its own crews erect the structure on site.

blocks.text: Structural steel fabrication is the making of load-carrying steel parts from plates and sections. The parts are cut, drilled, welded and painted in a workshop, then bolted or welded together on site. Steel Mind Engineers fabricates to your drawings or to drawings prepared by its own engineers.

Columns and Beams form the main frame of a building. Trusses are light, long-span roof members. Mezzanine Floors add extra floors inside buildings. Steel Bridges include footbridges and plant bridges. Crane Gantry Structures support outdoor cranes.
Material is checked on arrival, dimensions are checked after cutting and welds are inspected before painting. Read the SME Policy and the Fabrication page.
You can buy fabricated steel only, or you can ask Steel Mind Engineers to design, fabricate and erect the whole structure. See One-Step Solution.
